note: Names, descriptions and grades match the official list as reported by GTABase, PowerPyx, EGamers.io, KeenGamer, Output Lag and TechWiser (checked 2026-11-19). 27 trophies are visible on PSN, 28 stay hidden until earned. All guides are written in our own words; sources are cited per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.note: Platinum for earning every other trophy; roughly 200 hours, difficulty 4/10.
55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze; all single-player.
Platinum is a Mythic achievement on Xbox; none of the trophies are online.

steps: Earn the other 54 trophies — this one pops automatically when the last one lands.
There is no separate task: it is the reward for finishing the whole list.
Plan around the two trophies that need the most care: A Long Road (100% completion) and Positive Mental Attitude (the Chapter 1 meditation).
trophies.tip: No online trophies: the whole list is single-player and works offline.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.note: Opening mission trophy; part of the story roadmap.
Lists Gone Fishing as the first story mission.
Hidden trophy: complete Gone Fishing.

steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
It is the first mission of the game — no preparation is needed.
It unlocks as the story starts, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy — just start playing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.note: Finish Chapter 1; flags the Chapter 1 meditation in the same step.
Chapter 1 completion trophy.
Hidden trophy: complete Chapter 1.

steps: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1.
Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude. That session disappears after Chapter 1.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 until the meditation is done.
trophies.tip: Chapter 1 is where the only possibly-missable trophy lives — do the meditation first, then finish the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.note: Finish Chapter 2; both characters playable after Coffee Break.
Chapter 2 completion trophy.
Hidden trophy: complete Chapter 2.

steps: Finish every main mission in Chapter 2.
After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break you can play as both characters together — that unlocks the final meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude.
Billy's stranger strand also opens after Coffee Break; start it when it appears.
trophies.tip: Coffee Break is the key mission of this chapter: two playable characters from here on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.note: Finish Chapter 3.
Chapter 3 completion trophy.
Chapter 3 introduces the Andy, Randy and Tyrone strands.

steps: Finish every main mission in Chapter 3.
Chapter 3 opens several stranger strands (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) — start each one as soon as its icon appears.
Check your phone between missions: strangers call you when their next mission is ready.
trophies.tip: Chapter 3 is the busiest chapter for side strands — don't rush past the icons.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.note: Finish Chapter 4.
Chapter 4 completion trophy.
Hidden trophy: complete Chapter 4; vault robberies need the Chapter 4 mission.

steps: Finish every main mission in Chapter 4.
When the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' appears, play it — it unlocks bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal.
Bank vault runs bring 4 stars, so keep a fast bike ready from here on.
trophies.tip: The optional Chapter 4 mission is the gate for vault robberies — don't skip it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.note: Final mission trophy; free roam continues after the story, no mission replay.
Final mission trophy.
Hidden Gold trophy; sources differ on whether it is worded as Chapter 5.

steps: Finish the final mission of the story.
Before you start it, make one untouched manual save — there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so that save is your safety net.
After the credits, free roam stays open: almost everything left can still be done.
trophies.tip: One clean save before the finale protects the whole run.

trophies.name: Trust

sources.note: Story mission trophy.
Complete Breakfast Run.
Hidden trophy: complete Breakfast Run.

steps: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run.
It unlocks as you play through the campaign — no side requirements.
If it is not on your map yet, keep playing main missions until it appears.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.note: Story mission trophy.
Complete The Cartel Heist.
Hidden trophy: complete The Cartel Heist.

steps: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.
It is a main-mission trophy: it pops when the heist is done.
Heist practice helps later — vault and truck robberies use the same escape habits.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.note: Story mission trophy.
Complete Child's Play.
Hidden trophy: complete Child's Play.

steps: Complete the story mission Child's Play.
It unlocks through the main campaign.
No preparation or side mission is needed first.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.note: Story mission trophy.
Complete Headliners.
Hidden trophy: complete Headliners.

steps: Complete the story mission Headliners.
It appears as you work through the campaign.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter in case anything goes wrong.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.note: Story mission trophy.
Complete VCIA Takedown.
Hidden trophy: complete VCIA Takedown.

steps: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.
The airport setting is worth remembering — Catch Me If You Can also happens at VCIA, later, in free roam.
It unlocks through the main campaign.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy — and a preview of the VCIA trophy that comes later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.note: Story mission trophy.
Complete Operation Savage Glory.
Hidden trophy: complete Operation Savage Glory.

steps: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
It is one of the late campaign missions — it appears near the end of the story.
Finish it, then keep the pre-finale manual save habit for the last mission.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.note: Hardest trophy; thresholds lenient at ~60% of true completion; ~100 hours of checklist.
Checklist 45/45/10 split; nothing on it is missable; appears after the story.
Trophy vs checklist table: stunts 250/300, races 20/30, challenges 50/70, vaults 5/8, card sets 3/15.

steps: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story — the checklist only appears once the story is done.
Everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable (GTABase and PowerPyx agree).
The checklist splits into three parts (GTABase): 45% story and tasks, 45% exploration and activities, 10% discovery.
PowerPyx calls the thresholds lenient — roughly 60% of true completion — but it is still the longest grind: about 100 hours of the roughly 200-hour platinum.
trophies.tip: Trophy targets sit below checklist targets: 250 stunts vs 300, 20 race wins vs 30, 50 challenges vs 70, 5 vaults vs 8, 3 card sets vs 15. Keep going after each trophy pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.note: Any 250 of 397 stunts: 130 jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Same 250/397 split; under-the-bridge flights quickest; 100% wants 300.
Trophy 250 vs checklist 300.

steps: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up; the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed.
Track it in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map via Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.
Keep going after it pops: the 100% checklist wants 300.
trophies.tip: Any mix counts — pick the easiest kind near you and repeat it.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.note: 9 types listed: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade, race win, stunt.
Same 9 types; Progress > Activities shows what is left.
9 activity types, by GamesRadar+'s count.

steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race), and a stunt.
Check Progress > Activities to see what is left; most of these come naturally while working on other trophies.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the venues.
trophies.tip: You will do most of these automatically — don't grind it first.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.note: 42 golds across 12 ranges; ranges also raise Focus.
All 42 Shooting Range gold medals; linked guide for all 12 locations.
42 gold medals; ranges are also on the 100% checklist.

steps: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger — do them before that trophy.
PowerPyx says the gold medals are not too difficult — take them steadily across the playthrough, not in one sitting.
trophies.tip: 42 of 42 golds are also on the 100% checklist — nothing extra beyond this trophy.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.note: 14 locations, 42 drone races in total.
Win at all 14 Top Fun locations.
14 locations, by GamesRadar+'s count.

steps: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 drone races in total).
One win per location is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 42 races won.
Drone race wins also count for Master of None and for Earn Cash, Not Kudos.
trophies.tip: Learn one location's line, win it, move on.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.note: 20 different races; 40 unique race locations; 100% wants 30.
Win 20 different races.
Trophy 20 wins vs checklist 30.

steps: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count.
There are 40 unique race locations; the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won.
Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count as wins.
trophies.tip: Fold race wins into Top Fun and stunt routes instead of grinding races alone.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.note: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
Fishing challenge against Cal.
Beat Cal at fishing; quick early trophy.

steps: Find Cal and beat him in his fishing challenge.
Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also ticks Master of None.
Use the fishing spots marked on the map; Cal's challenge is a straight contest, not a gear check.
trophies.tip: Do it early — it is quick, and it teaches fishing for later.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.note: Complete any one arcade game.
Finish one arcade game.
Play an arcade game through to the end.

steps: Play any arcade cabinet game through to the end.
Arcade games are one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
Pick the shortest game on the first cabinet you find.
trophies.tip: One full playthrough is enough — no high score is needed.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.note: Andy strand is Lucia-only; missions listed through Puff Puff Pass.
Stranger chains have windows tied to story progress (single-source warning).
Five stranger finales listed as time-limited warnings.

steps: Play Andy's strand as Lucia — her missions are Lucia-only: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass, the finale.
Start the strand as soon as it appears in Chapter 3 and finish it before pushing far into the story.

TechWiser reports stranger chains have windows tied to story progress — a single-source warning, so start early to be safe. PowerPyx notes trophy quest-givers return after the story, so this is time-limited, not confirmed missable.
trophies.tip: Andy is Lucia-only: switch to her when his icon appears.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.note: Kenton marked after Island Dreams; temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1, back in Chapter 2–3; not missable.
Stranger chains have windows tied to story progress (single-source warning).
Kenton finale listed among the time-limited stranger trophies.

steps: Kenton's line is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls you, then his green 'KR' icon appears in Key Lento.
After Chapter 1 Kenton is temporarily unavailable; he comes back in Chapter 2–3 — while playing as Jason he texts you and his objectives return.
Finish his chain when it is available rather than leaving it to the end (TechWiser window warning).
trophies.tip: A gap in availability is normal — he returns. The warning is to start early, not to panic.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.note: Billy's 5 quests listed; all still available after the story.
Stranger chains have windows tied to story progress (single-source warning).
Billy finale listed among the time-limited stranger trophies.

steps: Billy's line is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County.
Complete his 5 jobs in order: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (Steal the Impaler), Hometown Heroes (the finale).
All his quests are still available after the story (PowerPyx) — but start the chain when it unlocks (TechWiser).
trophies.tip: Five jobs, one crew — run them back to back.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.note: 8 strands needed; guide to all side missions by chapter.
Some strands are chapter-gated; next missions arrive by phone call, sometimes weeks later.
8 stranger mission strands; Shirley's missions are Chapter 1 only.

steps: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida.

Not every side character counts toward the 8: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count, while Shirley, Moses, Billy, Andy, Yasmani, Tyrone and Eddie do not — check the trophy counter before and after a strand's last mission to confirm which ones moved it.
Some strands are chapter-gated — Shirley's two missions are Chapter 1 only — so start strands as soon as they appear.
After a mission, the next one takes a while: the character calls you, sometimes a few in-game weeks or a chapter later. Keep playing and watch your phone.
trophies.tip: The trophy counter is the source of truth — check it after each strand finale.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.note: Randy's strand: Wish List, then stealing the Zorrusso.
Stranger chains have windows tied to story progress (single-source warning).
Randy finale listed among the time-limited stranger trophies.

steps: Work Randy's strand when it unlocks in Chapter 3: Randy's Wish List, then Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), then the finale.
Start it as soon as it appears — TechWiser's window warning applies to all five stranger finales.
Check your phone and map markers between story missions; strands unlock in steps, not all at once.
trophies.tip: Randy's chain is short — clear it in one session.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.note: Tyrone opener is Jason-only; finale is Spin On This.
Stranger chains have windows tied to story progress (single-source warning).
Tyrone finale listed among the time-limited stranger trophies.

steps: Meet Tyrone in Chapter 3 (Here, Kitty Kitty — Speak with Tyrone, Jason only), then Take Out Kitty Litter and the finale, Spin On This.
The first meeting is Jason-only — switch to Jason when his icon appears.
Start early per the TechWiser window warning; PowerPyx notes quest-givers return after the story, so this is time-limited, not confirmed missable.
trophies.tip: Jason-only opener — don't wait around as Lucia.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.note: 18 spots, 10 locations; balcony session +1 but unmarked — unconfirmed if required; author did it and earned the trophy.
18 spots; balcony meditation gone after Chapter 1; not confirmed whether the trophy needs it.
Only trophy flagged as possibly missable by both GTABase and PowerPyx.
100% checklist needs 15 of 18 meditations; trophy needs 18.

steps: Meditate at every spot: 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice.

CHAPTER 1 FIRST: the morning after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and choose Accept. That session is gone after Chapter 1.

The balcony session adds +1 to the counter in the Progress menu but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest — PowerPyx and GTABase both say it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do it anyway: PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy.
The final meditation needs both characters together, possible after Chapter 2: Coffee Break.
Track it in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 — the trophy needs all 18.
trophies.tip: Keep a Chapter 1 save until this pops — there is no mission replay.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.note: Bret's hunting strand; which animal is unconfirmed.
Hunt a unique animal for Bret; animal unconfirmed.
Bret's Target Decks are the card sets; his hunts feed Fair Game.

steps: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — his strand is the hunting line, played as Jason.
Which animal the trophy wants is still unconfirmed at launch (EGamers.io, PowerPyx).
Follow Bret's quests as they appear and check the trophy counter after each hunt.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed target — treat any Bret hunt as progress, and verify before grinding.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.note: 3 card sets for the trophy; 15 Target Decks for 100%.
Bret's 15 Target Decks on the 100% checklist.
Trophy 3 sets vs checklist 15.

steps: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets (Bret's Target Decks).
The 100% checklist wants all 15 Target Decks — the trophy is the first fifth of that hunt.
Collect cards as you explore; a set completes when every card in it is found.
trophies.tip: 3 sets for the trophy, 15 for 100% — keep collecting past the pop.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.note: WAiNK at 100 locations; also 100 on the checklist.
WAiNK locations count toward the trophy and 100%.
Trophy 100 vs checklist 100 — this line ends with the trophy.

WAiNK also scans vehicles for Whip It Good — fold the two together and scan vehicles wherever you WAiNK.
The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy finishes that line.
trophies.tip: Scan everything you pass — it adds up fast.

trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.note: 50 challenges; 100% wants 70 of 80, hardest 10 skippable.
Challenges overlap with stunts, races and ranges.
Trophy 50 vs checklist 70.

steps: Complete 50 Challenges.
The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80 challenges — you can skip the hardest 10.
Challenges overlap with stunts, races and shooting ranges, so most complete while you work on other trophies.
trophies.tip: 50 for the trophy, 70 for 100% — don't stop at 50 if you're going for the platinum.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.note: 4 stars with partner, then escape; train tunnel north of Ambrosia.
Bank vault robberies often bring the wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone with your partner.

steps: With your partner, reach a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it and escape the heat.
Both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape route; bank vault robberies often bring the wanted level you need.
Escape the red heat zone on the map — hiding inside it does not count.
trophies.tip: Pair it with a bank vault run: the heat comes free.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.note: 3 shops in a row while still wanted; if no pop, rob a fourth.
North Vice City jewelry stores sit close together.
Three shop robberies in a row alongside your partner.

steps: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level.
Stay wanted the whole time — the three robberies must chain while the wanted level holds.
North Vice City's jewelry stores sit close together, which makes the chain easy. If the trophy does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth.
trophies.tip: Plan the route first: three close shops, no driving across the map.

trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.note: Scan 100 vehicles with WAiNK; no need to drive them.
100 vehicles for the trophy; 100% wants 200 of 277 base models.
Discover 100 vehicles.

steps: Discover 100 vehicles — scan them with WAiNK; you do not need to drive them.
Scanning traffic near busy roads is efficient (GTABase).
The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models — keep scanning past 100.
trophies.tip: Scan, don't steal: a busy road beats a garage.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.note: Fill Focus first, assault rifle, gang members count; cops, soldiers, civilians don't appear to.
5 enemies in one Combat Focus.
Ranges raise Focus, which helps Gunslinger.

steps: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
Fill Focus before you start, use an assault rifle, and aim for gang members — cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count.
Shooting ranges raise your Focus level, which makes this easier.
trophies.tip: One Focus, five gang members — pick a gang fight, not a police chase.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.note: Steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away.
Unscheduled departure at VCIA.
Hidden trophy: make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away (GTABase).
Expect a wanted level the moment you take the jet; climb fast and put distance between you and the airport.
Land somewhere quiet once the trophy pops.
trophies.tip: The jet is the hard part — getting aboard unseen matters more than the flight.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.note: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station; take out enemies from inside.
Tank trophy at Mile Zero Air Station.
Hidden trophy: deal with Rhinos (tanks).

steps: Steal a tank (Rhino) from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it (GTABase).
Tanks draw heavy attention — plan an escape route before you climb in.
Any enemies taken out from inside the tank count toward the trophy.
trophies.tip: Mile Zero is the place; the tank does the work.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.note: Snap Gun on the back door, find the safe code, clear the safe unseen.
Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
Undetected jewelry store robbery.

steps: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
Open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, and clear out the safe without anyone spotting you.
Go at a quiet hour and leave the same way you came in.
trophies.tip: Undetected means nobody sees you at all — not just no alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.note: Needs the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'; follow a security van; expect 4 stars.
5 vaults for the trophy; 8 for 100%.
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape.

steps: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape.
First unlock vault robberies with the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — after it, follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open.
Expect 4 stars on every vault run; have a fast bike ready for the escape.
The 100% checklist wants 8 vaults — keep robbing past 5.
trophies.tip: The Chapter 4 mission is the gate — don't miss it when it appears.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.note: Rob an armored truck and escape.
Armored truck robbery.
One truck, one clean getaway.

steps: Rob an armored truck and escape.
Armored trucks run set routes — watch one, hit it when it stops, and leave fast.
A fast bike or a car stashed nearby makes the escape.
trophies.tip: One truck, one clean getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.note: Clear the fog across all of Leonida; flying over dark patches is quickest.
Explore all of Leonida; plane available early in Chapter 1.
Unfog the map to explore all of Leonida.

steps: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from every area of the map.
Flying over the dark patches is reportedly the quickest method; a plane is available early in Chapter 1.
Unfogging also marks activity venues for Master of None.
trophies.tip: Fly the fog off in long sweeps — don't drive it.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

9 gangs to hit, one operation each.
Rob one illegal operation of each gang.

Mark gang operations on the map as you find them and clear one for each gang.
trophies.tip: Nine gangs, nine robberies — track which gangs you've already hit.
